name: xdownload
description: X / Twitter video downloader — Cloudflare Worker (app host + video proxy). The app is a Vue 3 SPA built with Vite; Vue is bundled and served from our own origin (no CDN single-point-of-failure). The Worker serves the built assets (dist/) and proxies twimg video.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy && npm run smoke
